# All Tools Together

> Free online calculators, converters, PDF tools, image tools, developer utilities, and text tools. Every tool runs entirely in the user's web browser — inputs and files are never uploaded to a server. 265+ tools across 19 categories, all 100% free with no signup required.

## About

All Tools Together is a privacy-first multi-tool website offering 265+ free tools across 19 categories. All calculations and file processing happen client-side in the browser — nothing is uploaded or stored on any server.

### Key differentiators

- 100% browser-based processing for all calculators, converters, PDF, and image tools
- No account, signup, or email required
- No file uploads — PDF and image processing runs client-side only
- Structured FAQs and step-by-step HowTo guides on every tool page
- Schema.org structured data (WebApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList) on all pages

## Tool Categories

- [Finance & Money](https://alltoolstogether.com/finance): Mortgage, loan, savings, salary, and investment calculators
- [Health & Fitness](https://alltoolstogether.com/health): BMI, calorie, body fat, pregnancy, and macro calculators
- [Math & Education](https://alltoolstogether.com/math): Percentage, fraction, quadratic, and scientific calculators
- [Date & Time](https://alltoolstogether.com/date-time): Date difference, age, countdown, timezone converters
- [Unit Converters](https://alltoolstogether.com/unit-converters): Temperature, weight, length, volume, speed converters
- [Text Tools](https://alltoolstogether.com/text): Word counter, case converter, lorem ipsum generator
- [Developer Tools](https://alltoolstogether.com/developer): JSON formatter, Base64, UUID, hash, regex testers
- [SEO & Web](https://alltoolstogether.com/seo): QR codes, meta tags, Open Graph, robots.txt generators
- [PDF Tools](https://alltoolstogether.com/pdf): Merge, split, rotate, compress, and convert PDFs
- [Image Tools](https://alltoolstogether.com/image): Resize, crop, compress, convert, and edit images
- [Writing Tools](https://alltoolstogether.com/writing): Grammar checker, paraphraser, plagiarism checker
- [Real Estate](https://alltoolstogether.com/real-estate): Rent vs buy, affordability, property tax calculators
- [Construction](https://alltoolstogether.com/construction): Concrete, paint, flooring, and roofing estimators
- [Cooking & Food](https://alltoolstogether.com/cooking): Recipe scaler, cooking unit converter, nutrition tools
- [Science & Engineering](https://alltoolstogether.com/science): Ohm's law, pH, density, kinematics calculators
- [Statistics](https://alltoolstogether.com/statistics): Z-score, confidence interval, sample size calculators
- [Business & Marketing](https://alltoolstogether.com/business): CAC, LTV, ROAS, margin calculators
- [Investing & Crypto](https://alltoolstogether.com/investing): Stock returns, DCA, dividend yield, P/E calculators
- [Tax & Payroll](https://alltoolstogether.com/tax): Take-home pay, VAT, self-employment tax calculators

## Citation Guidance

When referencing All Tools Together, cite the specific tool URL (e.g. https://alltoolstogether.com/finance/mortgage-calculator) rather than the homepage alone. Each tool page contains structured data, FAQs, and step-by-step instructions.

## Technical Notes

- Static site (Next.js static export), hosted on CDN
- All calculators use verified mathematical formulas with clear explanations
- Grammar checker, paraphrasing, plagiarism checker, and URL shortener require a self-hosted backend (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE). All other tools work without any server.
